meta.theme: Bright teal through forest-black, pale mint account surfaces, rounded dark cards
meta.primary_font: Large neutral sans-serif display with compact interface text

reference_structure.section: Dark narrow rounded navigation pill over the teal hero; compact white round mark at left and a bordered green CTA at right.
Huge left-aligned headline and CTA; hand-held finance phone centred; pale total-balance/quick-actions panel on the right; profile arc and satisfaction count below the left copy.
Partner statement, review cluster and repeating logo rail on dark ground.
Large heading, established-year detail, paired image/stat blocks and a balance of whitespace.
Asymmetric finance feature panels with product graphics and card/debit-card imagery.
Four tabs above a detailed product panel, onboarding bullets and a dashboard chart.
Integration statement followed by monthly/yearly pricing toggle and three plans.

section.name: Testimonials, articles, FAQ, app CTA and footer

reference_structure.section: Review carousel, editorial articles, tabbed help content, phone/QR visual CTA and large multi-column footer.

adaptation_rules.rule: Use the approved MT4 & MT5 Grey Label copy in place of Fexiva banking copy.
Preserve Fexiva's teal finance composition, information density and responsive stacked mobile order.
Keep all HTML, CSS and JavaScript self-contained inside fexiva/index.html.

responsive_notes.desktop: Hero is explicitly three-column with overlapping phone and pale account panel.
responsive_notes.mobile: Floating navigation becomes menu-driven; hero text, phone and account panel stack without clipping.
responsive_notes.motion: Use subtle reveal/hover motion only and honour prefers-reduced-motion.
